easy.en:
# Product Reject and Filtering Station

- **Difficulty:** Easy (easy)
- **POU:** `FB_C01`
- **Primary axis:** `sorting_filtering`

## Requirements

A conveyor transports parts past an inspection sensor. A part is defective when `DefectSensor` is TRUE while `PartPresent` is TRUE. The conveyor runs while `RunSwitch` is TRUE, unless the batch is complete. The batch size is 5 parts.

When a rising edge of `PartPresent` occurs while the conveyor is enabled:
- if `DefectSensor` is TRUE, count the part as rejected, activate `RejectPusher` for 1 s and then retract it;
- otherwise count the part as accepted.

When the total number of classified parts reaches 5, set `BatchFull` to TRUE and stop the conveyor. Pressing `ResetButton` clears both counters, clears `BatchFull` and allows a new batch. `RejectPusher` must never be active when `BatchFull` is TRUE.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `RunSwitch` | `BOOL` | Enables the conveyor |
| Input | `PartPresent` | `BOOL` | Part is present at the inspection point |
| Input | `DefectSensor` | `BOOL` | TRUE when the present part is defective |
| Input | `ResetButton` | `BOOL` | Clears counters and batch-full state |
| Output | `ConveyorMotor` | `BOOL` | Conveyor drive command |
| Output | `RejectPusher` | `BOOL` | Defective-part pusher command |
| Output | `AcceptCount` | `INT` | Number of accepted parts in the batch |
| Output | `RejectCount` | `INT` | Number of rejected parts in the batch |
| Output | `BatchFull` | `BOOL` | Batch of 5 parts completed |

easy.en:
# Two-Hand Safety Press

- **Difficulty:** Easy (easy)
- **POU:** `FB_C02`
- **Primary axis:** `safety_logic`

## Requirements

A press may close only when both operator buttons (`LeftButton`, `RightButton`) are held and a part is present (`PartPresent`). The press output `PressOutput` follows the two buttons while the safety conditions are satisfied.

Safety requirements:
- If one button is held alone for more than 500 ms, latch `Fault` to TRUE. While `Fault` is TRUE, `PressOutput` must remain FALSE.
- `ResetButton` clears `Fault` only when neither button is held.
- When `PressOutput` falls from TRUE to FALSE, emit a one-scan `CycleComplete` pulse.
- `PressOutput` must never be TRUE without `PartPresent`.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `LeftButton` | `BOOL` | Left operator button |
| Input | `RightButton` | `BOOL` | Right operator button |
| Input | `PartPresent` | `BOOL` | Part is present in the press |
| Input | `ResetButton` | `BOOL` | Clears the fault latch |
| Output | `PressOutput` | `BOOL` | Press closes while TRUE |
| Output | `CycleComplete` | `BOOL` | One-scan pulse after a press cycle |
| Output | `Fault` | `BOOL` | Anti-tiedown fault latched |

# Automatic Barrier Gate

- **Difficulty:** Easy (easy)
- **POU:** `FB_C03`
- **Primary axis:** `cyclic_timing`

## Requirements

A vehicle barrier opens when `OpenButton` is pressed (rising edge), when a vehicle is detected (`VehiclePresent`), or when the safety beam is interrupted (`SafetyBeam`). The gate remains open while `VehiclePresent` or `SafetyBeam` is TRUE.

When the gate is open and there is no vehicle, no beam interruption and no open command, the gate closes automatically after 3 s. If `SafetyBeam` becomes TRUE while the gate is closed, the gate reopens immediately and `WarningLight` is TRUE. `WarningLight` follows `SafetyBeam`. `GateOpen` and `GateClosed` are mutually exclusive and describe the gate state.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `VehiclePresent` | `BOOL` | Vehicle loop detector |
| Input | `OpenButton` | `BOOL` | Manual open command |
| Input | `SafetyBeam` | `BOOL` | Safety beam interrupted (obstacle) |
| Output | `GateOpen` | `BOOL` | Gate is fully open |
| Output | `GateClosed` | `BOOL` | Gate is fully closed |
| Output | `WarningLight` | `BOOL` | Safety warning lamp |

# Star-Delta Motor Starter

- **Difficulty:** Medium (medium)
- **POU:** `FB_C04`
- **Primary axis:** `cyclic_timing`

## Requirements

Implement a star-delta starter. A rising edge of `StartButton` energizes `MainContactor` and `StarContactor`. After 3 s the star contactor is de-energized and `DeltaContactor` is energized. `MainContactor` stays energized while the motor runs.

`StopButton` or `Overload` must stop the motor immediately. `Overload` latches `Fault`; `ResetButton` clears it only when `Overload` is FALSE. `StarContactor` and `DeltaContactor` must never be TRUE at the same time.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `StartButton` | `BOOL` | Start command |
| Input | `StopButton` | `BOOL` | Stop command |
| Input | `Overload` | `BOOL` | Thermal overload trip |
| Input | `ResetButton` | `BOOL` | Clears the fault latch |
| Output | `MainContactor` | `BOOL` | Main contactor |
| Output | `StarContactor` | `BOOL` | Star contactor |
| Output | `DeltaContactor` | `BOOL` | Delta contactor |
| Output | `Running` | `BOOL` | Motor is running |
| Output | `Fault` | `BOOL` | Overload fault latched |

# Car Wash Sequence

- **Difficulty:** Medium (medium)
- **POU:** `FB_C05`
- **Primary axis:** `cyclic_timing`

## Requirements

A car wash cycle starts on a rising edge of `StartButton` when `VehiclePresent` is TRUE. The cycle is:
1. conveyor and foam for 2 s;
2. conveyor and brush for 2 s;
3. conveyor and rinse for 1 s;
4. conveyor and dry fan for 1 s;
then the conveyor stops and `CycleComplete` is TRUE.

`EmergencyStop` immediately switches off all actuators and latches `Fault`; `ResetButton` clears the fault. A new cycle cannot start while `Fault` is TRUE. `CycleComplete` is cleared by `ResetButton` or by a new start.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `StartButton` | `BOOL` | Starts a wash cycle |
| Input | `EmergencyStop` | `BOOL` | Emergency stop |
| Input | `VehiclePresent` | `BOOL` | Vehicle in the wash bay |
| Input | `ResetButton` | `BOOL` | Clears the emergency fault |
| Output | `ConveyorMotor` | `BOOL` | Conveyor drive |
| Output | `FoamValve` | `BOOL` | Foam valve |
| Output | `BrushMotor` | `BOOL` | Brush motor |
| Output | `RinseValve` | `BOOL` | Rinse valve |
| Output | `DryFan` | `BOOL` | Dry fan |
| Output | `CycleComplete` | `BOOL` | Wash cycle finished |
| Output | `Fault` | `BOOL` | Emergency fault latched |

# Elevator Door Control

- **Difficulty:** Medium (medium)
- **POU:** `FB_C06`
- **Primary axis:** `safety_logic`

## Requirements

Control an elevator door with open and close commands. `DoorOpen` and `DoorClosed` report the limit switches. `OpenButton` starts opening; `CloseButton` starts closing only while `ObstacleSensor` is FALSE.

If the door is open with no obstacle, no open command and no close command, it closes automatically after 5 s. If `ObstacleSensor` is TRUE, the door must never close and `WarningBuzzer` is TRUE. If the obstacle appears while closing, the door reverses to opening. Both limit switches TRUE is an invalid state: latch `Fault`, stop the motors, and clear it with `ResetButton`.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `OpenButton` | `BOOL` | Open door command |
| Input | `CloseButton` | `BOOL` | Close door command |
| Input | `ObstacleSensor` | `BOOL` | Obstacle in the door path |
| Input | `DoorOpenLimit` | `BOOL` | Door fully open limit switch |
| Input | `DoorClosedLimit` | `BOOL` | Door fully closed limit switch |
| Input | `ResetButton` | `BOOL` | Clears the invalid-limit fault |
| Output | `DoorMotorOpen` | `BOOL` | Open motor |
| Output | `DoorMotorClose` | `BOOL` | Close motor |
| Output | `DoorOpen` | `BOOL` | Door is open |
| Output | `DoorClosed` | `BOOL` | Door is closed |
| Output | `WarningBuzzer` | `BOOL` | Obstacle warning |
| Output | `Fault` | `BOOL` | Invalid limit state latched |

# Bottle Height Sorting

- **Difficulty:** Medium (medium)
- **POU:** `FB_C07`
- **Primary axis:** `sorting_filtering`

## Requirements

A conveyor moves bottles past an analog height sensor. When a rising edge of `PartPresent` occurs while `RunSwitch` is TRUE, classify `HeightSensor`:
- 40.0 to 60.0 inclusive: accepted bottle; pulse `AcceptGate` for 500 ms and increment `AcceptCount`;
- outside that range: rejected bottle; pulse `RejectGate` for 500 ms and increment `RejectCount`.

A sensor value below 0.0 or above 100.0 is invalid: latch `Fault`, stop the conveyor and inhibit both gates. `ResetButton` clears the counters and the fault. `AcceptGate` and `RejectGate` must never be TRUE together.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `RunSwitch` | `BOOL` | Enables the conveyor |
| Input | `PartPresent` | `BOOL` | Bottle at the height sensor |
| Input | `HeightSensor` | `REAL` | Measured bottle height in mm |
| Input | `ResetButton` | `BOOL` | Clears counters and fault |
| Output | `ConveyorMotor` | `BOOL` | Conveyor drive |
| Output | `AcceptGate` | `BOOL` | Accept diverter gate |
| Output | `RejectGate` | `BOOL` | Reject diverter gate |
| Output | `AcceptCount` | `INT` | Accepted bottle count |
| Output | `RejectCount` | `INT` | Rejected bottle count |
| Output | `Fault` | `BOOL` | Invalid sensor value latched |

# Greenhouse Irrigation Zones

- **Difficulty:** Medium (medium)
- **POU:** `FB_C08`
- **Primary axis:** `cyclic_timing`

## Requirements

An irrigation cycle starts on a rising edge of `StartButton`. Three zones are visited in order. For each zone, if its moisture is below 30.0, open its valve and run `Pump` for 3 s; if the moisture is 30.0 or higher, skip the zone immediately.

After zone 3 the cycle ends: all valves and the pump are OFF and `CycleComplete` is TRUE. `StopButton` aborts the cycle immediately and clears `CycleComplete`. `ResetButton` clears `CycleComplete`. The pump must run whenever any zone valve is open.

## Interface Definition

| Input | `StartButton` | `BOOL` | Starts an irrigation cycle |
| Input | `StopButton` | `BOOL` | Aborts the cycle |
| Input | `Zone1Moisture` | `REAL` | Soil moisture of zone 1 |
| Input | `Zone2Moisture` | `REAL` | Soil moisture of zone 2 |
| Input | `Zone3Moisture` | `REAL` | Soil moisture of zone 3 |
| Input | `ResetButton` | `BOOL` | Clears cycle-complete state |
| Output | `Zone1Valve` | `BOOL` | Zone 1 valve |
| Output | `Zone2Valve` | `BOOL` | Zone 2 valve |
| Output | `Zone3Valve` | `BOOL` | Zone 3 valve |

# Conveyor Zone Accumulation

- **Difficulty:** Hard (hard)
- **POU:** `FB_C09`
- **Primary axis:** `sorting_filtering`

## Requirements

A three-zone conveyor moves parts downstream. `Zone1Sensor`, `Zone2Sensor` and `Zone3Sensor` indicate a part in each zone. A zone motor runs only when its zone has a part and the downstream zone is free. Zone 3 additionally requires `ReleaseButton` to discharge.

`Zone1Full` means zone 1 and zone 2 both contain a part; `Zone2Full` means zones 2 and 3 both contain a part; `Zone3Full` means zone 3 has a part and `ReleaseButton` is FALSE. If a zone has a part but its motor cannot run for more than 5 s, latch `JamAlarm`, switch all motors OFF and require `ResetButton` to clear the alarm.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `RunSwitch` | `BOOL` | Enables the conveyor line |
| Input | `Zone1Sensor` | `BOOL` | Part in zone 1 |
| Input | `Zone2Sensor` | `BOOL` | Part in zone 2 |
| Input | `Zone3Sensor` | `BOOL` | Part in zone 3 |
| Input | `ReleaseButton` | `BOOL` | Discharge zone 3 |
| Input | `ResetButton` | `BOOL` | Clears the jam alarm |
| Output | `Zone1Motor` | `BOOL` | Zone 1 motor |
| Output | `Zone2Motor` | `BOOL` | Zone 2 motor |
| Output | `Zone3Motor` | `BOOL` | Zone 3 motor |
| Output | `Zone1Full` | `BOOL` | Zone 1 blocked by zone 2 |
| Output | `Zone2Full` | `BOOL` | Zone 2 blocked by zone 3 |
| Output | `Zone3Full` | `BOOL` | Zone 3 waiting for release |
| Output | `JamAlarm` | `BOOL` | Jam latched |

hard.en:
# Boiler Purge and Ignition Sequence

- **Difficulty:** Hard (hard)
- **POU:** `FB_C10`
- **Primary axis:** `safety_logic`

## Requirements

A burner start is a supervised sequence. A rising edge of `StartButton` starts a 3 s purge with `PurgeFan`. After the purge, `Igniter` runs for 2 s. If `FlameSensor` becomes TRUE during ignition, open `FuelValve`, set `FlameOn` and turn the igniter OFF. If no flame is proven within 2 s, latch `Lockout` and stop the sequence.

While firing, loss of flame latches `Lockout` and closes `FuelValve`. `StopButton` stops the burner without lockout. `EmergencyStop` stops the burner and latches `Fault`. `ResetButton` clears `Lockout` and `Fault` only when `StartButton` and `FlameSensor` are FALSE. `FuelValve` requires `FlameOn`; `Igniter` and `FuelValve` must never be TRUE together.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `StartButton` | `BOOL` | Burner start command |
| Input | `StopButton` | `BOOL` | Normal stop |
| Input | `EmergencyStop` | `BOOL` | Emergency stop |
| Input | `FlameSensor` | `BOOL` | Flame proven |
| Input | `ResetButton` | `BOOL` | Clears lockout and fault |
| Output | `PurgeFan` | `BOOL` | Purge fan |
| Output | `Igniter` | `BOOL` | Ignition transformer |
| Output | `FuelValve` | `BOOL` | Fuel valve |
| Output | `FlameOn` | `BOOL` | Flame established |
| Output | `Lockout` | `BOOL` | Ignition lockout latched |
| Output | `Fault` | `BOOL` | Emergency fault latched |

# Palletizer Layer Counting

- **Difficulty:** Hard (hard)
- **POU:** `FB_C11`
- **Primary axis:** `sorting_filtering`

## Requirements

A palletizer receives boxes on a conveyor. A rising edge of `BoxPresent` while `RunSwitch` is TRUE and the pallet is not full counts one box. Every 3 boxes form a layer: increment `LayerCount`, pulse `LayerPush` for 1 s and reset the box count. When `LayerCount` reaches 2, set `PalletFull` and stop the conveyor. `ResetButton` clears the box count, layer count and `PalletFull`. The conveyor must stop while `LayerPush` is active.

| Output | `LayerPush` | `BOOL` | Layer pusher |
| Output | `BoxCount` | `INT` | Boxes in the current layer |
| Output | `LayerCount` | `INT` | Completed layers |
| Output | `PalletFull` | `BOOL` | Pallet complete |

hard.en:
# Safety Light Curtain Muting

- **Difficulty:** Hard (hard)
- **POU:** `FB_C12`
- **Primary axis:** `safety_logic`

## Requirements

A conveyor is protected by `LightCurtain` (TRUE means blocked). If the curtain is blocked while muting is not active, latch `SafetyStop` and stop the conveyor. `ResetButton` clears `SafetyStop` and `Alarm` only when `LightCurtain` is FALSE.

Muting requires a valid sequence: `MutingSensor1` must be activated first, then `MutingSensor2` within 2 s. A valid sequence activates `MutingActive` while both sensors remain TRUE. If `MutingSensor2` is activated without the sequence, or if the 2 s window expires, latch `Alarm`. The conveyor may run with the curtain blocked only while `MutingActive` is TRUE. `Alarm` also stops the conveyor.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `RunSwitch` | `BOOL` | Enables the conveyor |
| Input | `LightCurtain` | `BOOL` | Light curtain blocked |
| Input | `MutingSensor1` | `BOOL` | First muting sensor |
| Input | `MutingSensor2` | `BOOL` | Second muting sensor |
| Input | `ResetButton` | `BOOL` | Clears safety stop and alarm |
| Output | `ConveyorMotor` | `BOOL` | Conveyor drive |
| Output | `MutingActive` | `BOOL` | Muting is active |
| Output | `SafetyStop` | `BOOL` | Safety stop latched |
| Output | `Alarm` | `BOOL` | Muting alarm latched |
